respectNotes: Ask before photographing people at work, especially on the beach and at the ovens.
Before Homowo, the Ga Traditional Area keeps a month-long ban on drumming and noise-making (around May–June; dates are announced each year). Check whether it applies in Teshie that year.
During Homowo, follow the Traditional Council's and police guidance on where and when to watch, and dress in white if you are invited to join.
Visit Fort Augustaborg's ruins with someone from the town rather than alone.
[Sites and shrines that are not to be filmed. To confirm with the Traditional Council.]
